image_description: A vintage, rusted agricultural plow resting on dry, cracked earth. The implement features a heavy metal frame with two large, spoked iron wheels, a curved moldboard share on the right, and a partial share visible on the left. A complex, ornate metal arch structure rises above the frame, likely part of the seat or hitch mechanism. The background consists of blurred green foliage.
